difficulty_reason: The author identifies selected trek-system minors with partial derivatives and constructs a weight-preserving sign-reversing tail-swap involution for the obstruction term. This puts a positive principal covariance determinant in the derivative ideal and proves a graph-structured global real nonsingularity criterion, beyond routine determinant differentiation. The complete original local removal bijections, sign analysis and lowest-intersection cancellation proof are retained; named trek expansion and positivity prerequisites are uncounted context.
